diagnosis: Account uses Unified Auth with scoped API keys. Customer reports suspected token leak and wants immediate reset. Provide the standard rotation procedure and note there is no grace period on revocation.
reply: I understand the urgency — a leaked token must be handled right away. Because your account is on Unified Auth, your API access uses scoped keys rather than a single account-wide token. The safest immediate path is key rotation: create a replacement key with the scopes you need, switch your traffic to the new key, then revoke the compromised key. Revocation takes effect instantly with no grace period. If you need help during rotation, let me know the key name or scope details and I can step you through it.
